codes.emits_when: a list or custom rule blocked the request
an allow-rule matched; the request proceeded
a replace-rule intercepted the request before it reached the network
no rule matched; the request proceeded
no list bundle is bound yet; the request proceeded (data absence fails open)
a user exception scope covered the hit; the request proceeded
the blocking engine died; browsing continues fail-open with an amber chip
the engine reported poison; browsing continues fail-open with an amber chip
the kill switch is on; blocking is suspended with an amber chip
the egress route was lost; the request is held fail-closed (red chip)
